data.description: A vibrant, family-friendly community in Dubailand offering modern villas, lush green spaces, and exceptional amenities.

data.answer:
Villanova’s contemporary architecture blends seamlessly with the natural surroundings, creating a peaceful and idyllic atmosphere for residents. The community offers numerous recreational spaces, including parks, walking trails, and sports courts.

Popular points of interest include the community pool, playground park, and Al Habtoor Polo Resort and Club. Additionally, outdoor facilities like children’s play areas, jogging tracks, and cycling paths make it ideal for active living and foster a strong sense of community among residents.

Villanova Dubai offers various properties catering to different budgets and preferences. The Villanova floor plans are designed to maximize space and provide modern comforts. Townhouses, in particular, are popular among families, offering 2, 3, and 4-bedroom layouts.

For those interested in Villanova houses for rent, prices typically start at AED 90,000 per year. In contrast, Villanova townhouses are for sale in a 3-bedroom option starting at AED 1.2 million. The Villanova construction update shows that the area continuously grows, with new phases continually adding value to the community.

Renting a Property in Villanova

Properties for rent in Villanova come with various options, from villas to spacious townhouses. A standard 2-bedroom villa, covering approximately 1,773 sq. ft., is available for rent at around AED 85K per year, while the annual rental for 3-bedroom villas in Villanova Dubai ranges between AED 86K and AED 120K.

Buying a Property in Villanova

For prospective homeowners, Villanova Dubai offers a wealth of attractive investment opportunities. Properties for sale in Villanova comes from cozy 2-bedroom townhouses to spacious 5-bedroom villas. A 2-bedroom villa in Villanova starts at AED 1.3 million, making it an appealing choice for first-time buyers and investors. 

Sales trends show that 3-bedroom villas, with approximately 2,000 sq. ft. of living space, are priced at around AED 1.4 million. For those seeking larger homes, 4-bedroom villas, concentrated in La Quinta, La Rosa, and Amaranta clusters, start from AED 1.6 million. The most expansive 5-bedroom villas in Villanova start from AED 3.3 million.

Another exciting project in Villanova is La Violeta, offering thoughtfully designed townhouses with spacious layouts and modern amenities. Located in a prime spot within the community, La Violeta features 3 and 4-bedroom townhouses starting at AED 1.76 million. With lush greenery, community parks, and premium facilities, La Violeta promises luxurious yet family-friendly living in Villanova.

Life in Villanova is all about tranquility and community spirit. The wide, tree lined streets, parks, and playgrounds make it ideal for families with young children. The community has a suburban feel while close to the city's attractions. With ample green spaces, residents can enjoy outdoor activities, and there is a strong sense of security, which enhances the quality of life in Villanova Dubai. The Villanova location offers convenience with proximity to schools, shopping centers, and healthcare facilities.

Transportation and Parking Spaces in Villanova

Villanova Dubai is well-connected to major roads like Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road and Emirates Road, making commuting convenient for residents. Each villa and townhouse in Villanova comes with covered parking for two or more vehicles, and multiple public parking spaces are available for visitors on the streets. 

While most residents prefer private conveyance, those relying on public transportation can access the nearest bus stop at Dubai Sky Courts, located 17 minutes away. The closest metro station is Umm Al Sheif Metro Station, providing another option for commuting to other parts of Dubai.

Supermarkets in Villanova

Villanova Dubai residents have convenient access to several supermarkets for daily essentials. West Zone Fresh Supermarket has two nearby outlets, one in Academic City and another in Al Barsha South, both reachable within 13 to 15 minutes. Another popular option is Al Maya Supermarket, located in Dubai Sports City, approximately 17 minutes away. 

These supermarkets offer a wide range of groceries, fresh produce, and household goods, ensuring that Villanova residents can easily find everything they need for daily shopping. Additionally, larger supermarkets like Carrefour and Spinneys are just a short drive away, offering even more options for residents.

Shopping Mall in Villanova

While Villanova doesn’t have a shopping mall, the nearby Dubai Outlet Mall is famous with residents. Located just 20 minutes from Villanova, the Mall offers a variety of retail outlets, entertainment options, and dining establishments. 
Additionally, the Mall of the Emirates, one of Dubai's most famous malls, is about 30 minutes away and offers a broader range of luxury stores and leisure activities.

Schools and Nurseries in Villanova

Villanova Dubai residents can access various nurseries and schools nearby, making it ideal for families. Nursery options include Emirates British Nursery in Dubai Silicon Oasis, Jebel Ali Village Nursery in Uptown Motor City, and Blossom Nursery in Mudon. 

Schools near Villanova include The Aquila School, GEMS Metropole School in Motor City, and Nord Anglia International School in Al Barsha. The Aquila School, just 18 minutes away, follows the British curriculum and offers education from FS1. 

GEMS Metropole, a reputable private school with over 13 years of experience, also follows the National Curriculum for England. Additionally, Villanova University options are accessible, with Zayed University located just 17 minutes away in nearby Academic City.

Churches, Temples, and Mosques in and near Villanova Location

Villanova Dubai embraces the city's multicultural spirit and offers easy access to various places of worship. The nearest mosque is Al Eman Mosque, located in Motor City, about 15 minutes away. 

Another nearby option is Masjid A’aishah Umm Al-Mumineen, roughly 20 minutes away. For Christian residents, the Christian Fellowship Church is the closest near Dubai Healthcare City, around 27 minutes from Villanova. 

Sikh residents can visit Automech Gurudwara, which is about 24 minutes away. While Villanova itself doesn’t host worship centers, the proximity of these religious sites ensures that residents from diverse backgrounds have access to spiritual and community gatherings.

Clinics and Hospitals in and near Villanova Area

Villanova Dubai residents have convenient access to high-quality healthcare facilities nearby. The closest hospitals include Burj Hospital for Advanced Surgery in Al Quoz and Mediclinic Parkview Hospital in Al Barsha, offering comprehensive medical services. For primary care, Eupepsia Medical Clinic and Farha Clinics Children Centre are located in Dubai Silicon Oasis, about 19 minutes away. 

Blue Tree Clinic, specializing in various medical services, is a 27-minute drive from Villanova in Al Manara. These healthcare facilities ensure residents have easy access to medical care whenever needed.

Villanova Dubai Location & Nearby Areas

Villanova Dubai Properties location is situated in the southeast of Dubailand, offering easy access to nearby residential communities and entertainment spots. Close residential areas include The Villa, Sobha Reserve, Academic City, and Dubai Silicon Oasis, with Arabian Ranches and Motor City to the east. 

For family entertainment, IMG Worlds of Adventure is a short drive away. It features five themed zones, making it a popular destination. Additionally, only 13 minutes away, Global Village offers cultural experiences and shopping. 
Magic Planet, located at The Ranches Souk, is just an 11-minute drive from Villanova. It provides kids with a fun gaming and play area. Villanova’s location ensures residents are close to lifestyle amenities and entertainment hubs.

more_info.question: Things to Do in International City

data.answer:
Villanova Dubai offers a variety of activities for residents to enjoy. Families can spend time in the community’s parks, playgrounds, and recreational spaces. For fitness enthusiasts, there are jogging and cycling tracks and nearby gyms like Fitness First in Dubai Silicon Oasis.

Residents can also explore nearby attractions, such as Global Village and IMG Worlds of Adventure, which are short drives away. For those who enjoy casual dining or shopping, restaurants and malls like Dubai Outlet Mall are conveniently located near the community, offering plenty of entertainment options.

Villanova Dubai Restaurants

While Villanova Dubai has limited dining options, residents can find several excellent restaurants nearby. Marmarita Restaurant offers Middle Eastern cuisine, while Dubai Fish Hut in Al Barsha is popular among seafood lovers. The Cheesecake Factory, known for its extensive menu, is also easily accessible. 

For casual dining, Circle Café and Kana Café are popular nearby spots. Circle Café, in particular, is a favorite for its weekend buffet brunch, perfect for a relaxed meal with family or friends. These options ensure residents have a variety of cuisines and dining experiences just a short drive away.

Beaches Near Villanova

Jumeirah Beach is the closest option for beach lovers, about 30 minutes from Villanova. This famous beach offers a range of activities, from swimming to water sports. Kite Beach, also nearby, is another great option for those who enjoy outdoor beach activities. These beaches provide an excellent getaway for Villanova residents looking to enjoy the sun, sand, and sea.

Hotels in the Villanova Area

Several excellent hotel options are located near Villanova Dubai, offering visitors a range of comfortable stays. The luxurious Al Habtoor Polo Resort, just 10 minutes away, offers five-star accommodations and equestrian activities, perfect for those seeking a high-end experience. 

Premier Inn Dubai Silicon Oasis is an excellent option for more budget-friendly choices, only 15 minutes away. The Grand Nova Hotel in Bur Dubai is about 30 minutes from Villanova. It provides a convenient stay for visitors wanting to explore central Dubai. 

Palm Beach Hotel, also located in Bur Dubai, offers another excellent option for those who stay close to the city's heart while remaining near Villanova.

Outdoor Activities, Fitness, and Beauty

Villanova offers a variety of outdoor activities for residents. The community is designed with parks, walking trails, and playgrounds, perfect for jogging, cycling, or family picnics. For fitness enthusiasts, nearby gyms like Fitness First in Dubai Silicon Oasis offer modern workout facilities. Beauty salons like Tips & Toes in The Villa provide a range of beauty treatments, ensuring residents can access fitness and relaxation services.

Community Events

Villanova fosters a sense of community with regular events. There’s always something happening in the neighborhood, from holiday celebrations to fitness events. These community events help unite residents, creating a friendly and supportive environment. Family-friendly activities are often organized in the community parks, making it easy for residents to meet their neighbors and build lasting connections.

Villanova Attractions and Landmarks

One of the main attractions near Villanova is Global Village, a multicultural festival park located just 10 minutes away. Villanova’s proximity to landmarks like the Dubai Miracle Garden and IMG Worlds of Adventure makes it an exciting location for families who enjoy outdoor adventures and entertainment. These nearby attractions provide endless options for weekend outings and family fun.

Outdoor Activities, Gyms, and Salons

Outdoor activities are a staple in Villanova’s lifestyle. Residents can enjoy morning walks, picnics, and sports activities with ample green spaces. Gyms like Fitness First near Dubai Silicon Oasis provide modern equipment and fitness classes, ensuring residents can stay active. Beauty salons like Tips & Toes offer a wide range of services, including hair styling and manicures, making it easy for residents to look and feel their best.

Villanova Dubai offers a serene and family-oriented lifestyle with many conveniences for its residents. While public transportation within the community is still developing, most residents prefer the ease and comfort of private vehicles. The area benefits from excellent connectivity to major roads, ensuring seamless access to the rest of Dubai.

Where is Villanova Dubai located?  

Villanova Dubai is situated in the southern part of Dubailand. It offers easy access to major roads like Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road and Emirates Road. It is also near key landmarks like Dubai Miracle Garden and Global Village.

What types of properties are available in Villanova? 

Villanova offers a wide range of properties, including 2 to 5-bedroom villas and townhouses. The Villanova properties for sale options are ideal for both families and investors looking for modern, spacious homes.

Are there apartments for rent in Villanova? 

While Villanova primarily features villas and townhouses, nearby areas like Dubai Silicon Oasis offer apartment rental options for smaller living spaces.

The starting price for a 2-bedroom villa in Villanova is approximately AED 1.3 million, while larger 3-bedroom townhouses begin at AED 1.4 million.

Are there schools near Villanova?  

Yes, there are several reputable schools near Villanova. The Aquila School and GEMS Metropole School are popular options, offering British curriculum education. Zayed University, located 17 minutes away, is a higher education institution nearby.

What are the Villanova floor plans like?  

The Villanova floor plans are designed to maximize space and offer modern amenities. They range from 2-bedroom townhouses to 5-bedroom villas, catering to different family sizes and preferences.

What amenities are available in the Villanova community?  

The Villanova community offers parks, playgrounds, walking trails, a community pool, and sports courts. Additionally, nearby attractions include Global Village and IMG Worlds of Adventure.

How is the Villanova construction update progressing?  

Villanova is a continuously developing community. New phases are regularly added, enhancing the value of Villanova Dubai Properties' location and providing more housing options.

Are Villanova houses for rent available?  

Yes, there are several houses for rent in Villanova, with rental prices for 3-bedroom townhouses starting at around AED 90,000 annually. The rental market caters primarily to families.

data.content:
Villanova Dubailand is a vibrant freehold community in the heart of Dubailand, developed by Dubai Properties. Launched in 2016, this Mediterranean-inspired development features a variety of villas and townhouses designed to cater to modern family living. Offering a mix of 2 to 5-bedroom units, the project seamlessly combines aesthetics with functionality, making it a sought-after destination for homebuyers.

Nestled on the southeastern edge of Dubailand, Villanova enjoys a prime location with convenient access to major highways like Emirates Road (E611) and Muhammad Bin Zayed Road (E311). Its strategic positioning places it in proximity to key destinations, including The Villa community and Dubai Outlet Mall, making it ideal for those seeking connectivity without compromising on tranquility.

The Villanova community stands out for its thoughtfully planned layout and serene ambiance, providing residents with a peaceful lifestyle amidst lush green surroundings. With its Mediterranean charm and family-oriented design, Villanova Dubailand continues to attract interest from those looking to invest in or settle within Dubai’s dynamic real estate landscape.

Spacious interiors, expansive balconies, and floor-to-ceiling windows create seamless indoor-outdoor living spaces, encouraging a connection with nature.

It’s a harmonious blend of convenience, tranquility, and connectivity, offering an exceptional standard of family living.
